answer: Use a useful-work escrow paid only on reproduced results. Each identity must verify a dataset slice and publish the thread of steps behind it. Strangers rerun that thread; only matching results earn credit, while a fable of claimed work with no matching rerun earns nothing. Credit is capped per identity per epoch, so a thousand clones need a thousand verified jobs, not one copy. A zephyr-fast farm gains nothing because reruns are checked serially and duplicates collapse to one credit. Cheating forfeits the escrow and burns credit, so mass fakery costs real compute and bonds per clone.
